name: Student Science Training Program (SSTP)
org: University of Florida, Center for Precollegiate Education and Training
what_you_do: A 7 week program where you stay on campus. You work on a UF professor's research, go to a lecture series and take an honors class.
who_can_apply: Students in 11th grade who will be 16 or older at program start (no exceptions). Applied for in spring of 11th grade. A few spots go to students from outside Florida.
pay_detail: $5,500 program cost plus $50 application fee; limited need based scholarships for Florida high school students
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due March 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the CPET online portal, with transcripts. No minimum GPA, no test scores needed.
notes: Daily meals are not included in the fee. Need-based aid is for Florida high school students. Standardized tests are not required to apply.
